from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from core.parental import ParentalAgent, ParentalPolicyStore

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    store = ParentalPolicyStore(Path(tmp))
    agent = ParentalAgent(store)
    agent.apply_demo_policy(['kid'])
    status = agent.status()
    assert 'kid' in status.enabled_users
    assert status.remaining_minutes == 180
    assert agent.request_extra_time(15, user='kid')['ok'] is True
    agent.set_user_mode('kid', 'school')
    agent.record_usage('kid', 180)
    status = agent.status()
    assert status.locked is True
    assert store.lock_file.exists()
print('parental selftest ok')
PY

cd /home/abrahamt/Escritorio/zentrix-by-abraham-tobal/zentrix-os/zentrix-platform && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from core.parental import ParentalAgent, ParentalPolicyStore

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    agent = ParentalAgent(ParentalPolicyStore(Path(tmp)))
    agent.apply_demo_policy(['kid'])
    agent.update_apps([{'identifier':'/usr/bin/firefox','action':'allow','category':'education','always_allowed':True}])
    agent.update_internet({'mode':'pause','allowed_domains':['wikipedia.org'],'blocked_domains':['youtube.com']})
    agent.set_school_mode('kid', True)
    status = agent.status()
    assert status.mode == 'school'
    assert agent.show_policy()['internet']['mode'] == 'pause'
    assert agent.show_policy()['apps'][0]['identifier'] == '/usr/bin/firefox'
print('parental stage1b selftest ok')
PY

from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from core.parental_remote import RemoteParentalManager, RemoteStore

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    manager = RemoteParentalManager(RemoteStore(Path(tmp)))
    family = manager.create_family('Family', 'parent')
    device, code = manager.create_device(family.family_id, 'Abraham-PC')
    assert manager.pair_device(code)['ok'] is True
    assert manager.pair_device(code)['ok'] is False
    command = manager.queue_command(device.device_id, 'extra_time', {'minutes': 15})
    assert manager.mark_executed(command.command_id)['duplicate'] is False
    assert manager.mark_executed(command.command_id)['duplicate'] is True
    assert manager.sync_status(device.device_id, 'Online', offline=False)['status'] == 'Online'
print('stage2 remote selftest ok')
PY

cd /home/abrahamt/Escritorio/zentrix-by-abraham-tobal/zentrix-os/zentrix-platform && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from core.parental_remote import RemoteParentalManager, RemoteStore, SupabaseConfigStore

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    tmp_path = Path(tmp)
    manager = RemoteParentalManager(RemoteStore(tmp_path))
    manager.config_store = SupabaseConfigStore(tmp_path / 'parental-supabase.json')
    save = manager.save_supabase_config('https://example.supabase.co', 'anon-key', 'example', 'Familia Zentrix', 'parent')
    assert save['ok'] is True
    validation = manager.validate_supabase_config()
    assert validation['ok'] is True
    loaded = manager.load_supabase_config()
    assert loaded.family_name == 'Familia Zentrix'
print('supabase config selftest ok')
PY
